iterations.name: Security & Compliance Foundation (Critical)
iterations.description: OWASP MASVS standartlarına tam uyum ve güvenlik altyapısının tamamlanması

stories.title: OWASP MASVS V1-V7 Core Security Implementation
stories.description: OWASP MASTG guideline'larına göre temel mobil güvenlik standartlarını uygula
acceptance_criteria: MASVS-STORAGE: Android KeyStore & iOS Keychain entegrasyonu
MASVS-CRYPTO: AES-GCM-256 şifreleme, secure random generation
MASVS-AUTH: Biometric authentication & secure session management
MASVS-PLATFORM: Secure IPC & exported component protection
technical_requirements: Android: Implement EncryptedSharedPreferences with hardware-backed keystore
iOS: Keychain Services with kSecAttrAccessibleWhenUnlockedThisDeviceOnly
Network: Implement certificate pinning using TrustKit (iOS) / Network Security Config (Android)
Authentication: BiometricPrompt API (Android) / LocalAuthentication (iOS)
Anti-tampering: Root/jailbreak detection, debugger detection
Code protection: ProGuard/R8 optimization (Android), Swift obfuscation (iOS)

stories.title: Mobile Security Testing Suite Development
stories.description: Kapsamlı mobil güvenlik test suite'i ve otomatik scanning araçları
technical_requirements: SAST: MobSF, Semgrep rules for mobile-specific vulnerabilities
DAST: Frida-based dynamic analysis scripts
IAST: Runtime security monitoring hooks
CI/CD: Security gate integration with build pipeline
Reporting: SARIF format security reports
Metrics: Security debt tracking and trend analysis
